failure_summary.description: Agents imported a nonexistent `tools` module despite the skill explicitly requiring direct calls to injected functions.
Agents repeated already-satisfied work or skipped filtering a compatible cached result after the user added criteria.
An agent searched for a hotel without required stay dates and did not seek the missing information.
An agent omitted a previously stated party size from a hotel search.
An agent omitted a stated hotel neighborhood from the matching search field.

patch.reasoning: The highest-frequency failures—imports, cache handling, and missing required dates—are already explicitly addressed by the skill, and similar reinforcement edits have previously been rejected. The remaining omissions are isolated and overlap with previously rejected carry-forward and neighborhood edits, so no new edit is warranted.
